prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Sort the Tiles; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: A low pale wooden classroom table, morning. Kit and Zoe work beside two plain gray sorting mats.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Exactly four flat tiles: red circle, red square, blue circle, blue square; equal thickness and comparable size; Two plain gray mats side by side; No labels or extra shapes
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: All four tiles mixed; both mats empty.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Four tiles mixed between two empty gray mats. Kit points to the set; Zoe watches. Count exactly one red circle, red square, blue circle, blue square.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
Strict board scope: do not invent additional human cast, unrelated animals or objects. Show no story events after the initial state. The reference is for exact subjects specified above only; no copying irrelevant content from any cast reference.

visualReview.note: Directly viewed exact four tiles: red circle, red square, blue circle, blue square; gray sorting mats and low table. Kit/Zoe identities and scale consistent; final sequence separately checked for counts and regrouping.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image and sequence inspection; no classroom or physical-device observation.
